checkRuns.command:
mkdir -p src/routes/books src/components
cat > kay.config.ts <<'EOF'
import { defineConfig } from 'kay/server'

export default defineConfig({
  lang: 'en',
  seo: { name: 'Bookshelf', titleTemplate: '%s | Bookshelf', description: 'A small catalog of classic books.' },
})
EOF
cat > src/content.config.ts <<'EOF'
import { t } from 'kay'
import { collection } from 'kay/content'

export const books = collection('content/books', {
  schema: t.Object({
    title: t.String(),
    author: t.String(),
    year: t.Number(),
    rating: t.Number({ minimum: 1, maximum: 5 }),
    tags: t.Array(t.String(), { default: [] }),
  }),
})
EOF
cat > src/routes/_layout.kay <<'EOF'
--- server
const section = ctx.url.pathname.split('/')[1]
---
header
  a(href="/") Bookshelf
  nav(aria-label="Main")
    a(href="/books" aria-current={section === 'books' ? 'page' : undefined}) Books
    a(href="/about" aria-current={section === 'about' ? 'page' : undefined}) About
    a(href="/contact" aria-current={section === 'contact' ? 'page' : undefined}) Contact
main
  slot
footer © Bookshelf
EOF
cat > src/routes/_404.kay <<'EOF'
head
  title Not found
h1 Not found
a(href="/books") Back to the books
EOF
cat > src/routes/index.kay <<'EOF'
--- server
import { books } from '../content.config'

const top = (await books.all())
  .sort((a, b) => b.data.rating - a.data.rating || (a.data.title < b.data.title ? -1 : a.data.title > b.data.title ? 1 : 0))
  .slice(0, 3)
  .map(book => ({ slug: book.slug, title: book.data.title }))
---
head
  title(raw) Bookshelf
h1 Bookshelf
p A small catalog of classic books.
h2 Top rated
ol
  for book of top key={book.slug}
    li: a(href={`/books/${book.slug}`}) {book.title}
EOF
cat > src/routes/about.kay <<'EOF'
head
  title About
h1 About
p Bookshelf lists a few classic books worth reading.
EOF
cat > src/favorites.ts <<'EOF'
import { persisted } from 'kay'

export const favorites = persisted<string[]>('favorites', [], { storage: 'local' })
EOF
cat > src/components/book-list.kay <<'EOF'
---
import { favorites } from '../favorites'

interface Item { slug: string, title: string, author: string, year: number, tags: string[] }

const { items, tags } = props<{ items: Item[], tags: string[] }>()
const selected = signal('')
const shown = memo(() => items.filter(item => selected() === '' || item.tags.includes(selected())))
---
div(role="group" aria-label="Filter by tag")
  button(type="button" aria-pressed={selected() === '' ? 'true' : 'false'} onClick={() => selected.set('')}) All
  for tag of tags key={tag}
    button(type="button" aria-pressed={selected() === tag ? 'true' : 'false'} onClick={() => selected.set(tag)}) {tag}
ul(aria-label="Books")
  for item of shown key={item.slug}
    li
      a(href={`/books/${item.slug}`}) {item.title}
      span  {item.author}, {item.year}
      if favorites().includes(item.slug)
        span.favorite  Favorite
EOF
cat > src/components/favorite-button.kay <<'EOF'
---
import { favorites } from '../favorites'

const { slug } = props<{ slug: string }>()

function toggle() {
  favorites.set(list => list.includes(slug) ? list.filter(item => item !== slug) : [...list, slug])
}
---
button(type="button" onClick={toggle})
  if favorites().includes(slug)
    | Remove from favorites
  else
    | Add to favorites
EOF
cat > src/routes/books/index.kay <<'EOF'
--- server
import { books } from '../../content.config'
import BookList from '../../components/book-list.kay'

const items = (await books.all())
  .map(book => ({ slug: book.slug, title: book.data.title, author: book.data.author, year: book.data.year, tags: book.data.tags }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.title < b.title ? -1 : a.title > b.title ? 1 : 0)
const tags = [...new Set(items.flatMap(item => item.tags))].sort((a, b) => a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0)
---
head
  title Books
h1 All books
BookList(items={items} tags={tags})
EOF
cat > "src/routes/books/[slug].kay" <<'EOF'
--- server
import { books } from '../../content.config'
import FavoriteButton from '../../components/favorite-button.kay'

const book = await books.get(ctx.params.slug) ?? ctx.notFound()
const { Content } = book
const { title, author, year, rating, tags } = book.data
---
head
  title {title}
h1 {title}
p by {author}
p Published in {year}
p Rating: {rating}/5
ul
  for tag of tags key={tag}
    li: a(href="/books") {tag}
FavoriteButton(slug={book.slug})
article
  Content
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -40

bun run build 2>&1 | tail -15; (PORT=4567 bun run start > /tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3
for p in / /books /books/dracula /books/nope /about /contact /zzz; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -o /tmp/o.html -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4567$p; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/o.html; done
curl -s localhost:4567/ | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -n "aria-current\|<li\|<ol" 
curl -s localhost:4567/books | sed 's/></>\n</g' | head -60 | grep -v "^<link\|^<script"

sed -i 's|^  a(href="/") Bookshelf|  a(href="/" aria-current={undefined}) Bookshelf|' src/routes/_layout.kay
sed -i 's|^      span  {item.author}, {item.year}|      span {`${item.author}, ${item.year}`}|' src/components/book-list.kay
pkill -f "src/server.ts"; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3; (PORT=4567 bun run start > /tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3
curl -s localhost:4567/ | grep -o '<header>.*</header>'; curl -s localhost:4567/books | grep -o '<li>.\{0,200\}' | head -3
curl -s localhost:4567/books/dracula | grep -o '<main>.*</main>'
curl -s -X POST localhost:4567/_kay/action/contact/send -H 'Origin: http://localhost:4567' -d 'name=+&email=x&message=short' -H 'Referer: http://localhost:4567/contact' -o /tmp/p.html -w "%{http_code}\n"; grep -o '<main>.*</main>' /tmp/p.html | head -c 1500
pgrep -af "bun" | head; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3
